<subject>Re: Portfolio Review follow up</subject>
<body>
Great idea.

My key points would be that (a) the SEC needs to push ahead with its "right sized" investment vehicles and (b) focus on standardizing the prospectus and fund structure [no more collaborative efforts]. Two simple, easy to understand thoughts.

Also, I think that it's a mistake to use the term "large funds". We don't want large funds. We want funds that cover natural markets and benefit investors.

Preston
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Jacobs, Brent
Sent: Friday, October 17, 2025 8:05 AM
To: Shields, Victoria; Anthony, Robert Sanders.; Andrews, Rose; Davis, Alan; Moreno, Gregory; Andrade, Preston; Burton, Alison
Subject: Portfolio Review follow up

In the aftermath of Portfolio Review week and following up on Gregory's successful pre-briefings, we should be out spinning on the back end as well. Perhaps Alison, Victoria and I can come up with some thoughts on message points and send them around for comment. Sound OK?
</quoted>
